device_scope: One previously paired Android test phone.
actor: Instinct actual cloud environment using CLI.11 and an existing approved connection in multi-AI mode.

steps: Read a public post in Xiaohongshu.
Create a note containing its source and three relevant points.
Save, leave Notes, reopen the note and verify its contents.
Return to the launcher and release the task lease.
task.source_and_saved_note_comparison: The maintainer visually compared the source screenshots with the reopened note; the source reference and three points matched.

calls.counting_note: The three observation errors occurred on calls whose requested action returned exit zero. They are separate from the two rejected action calls.

action_failures_and_recovery.recovery: Call 12 read a fresh tree; call 13 set-text succeeded.

action_failures_and_recovery.cause: The agent supplied pixel coordinates to the normalized-image interface.
action_failures_and_recovery.recovery: Call 17 observed again; call 18 used normalized coordinates and succeeded.

post_action_observation_failures.continuation: Calls 8 and 9 queried windows and read a fresh tree.

time.limit: These are the retained command timestamps, not proof of uninterrupted observation of the phone.

maintainer_intervention.before_task: The APK upgrade was performed by the maintainer. This task does not establish autonomous upgrade recovery.
maintainer_intervention.during_task: Instinct reports no additional human intervention during the business task. The retained command chain is consistent with that report; it is not independent observation of every possible local action.

evidence.review: The returned task-specific stdout/stderr, errors and four source/note/launcher images were reviewed; unrelated existing content had been redacted by the sender.
evidence.capture_limit: The sender states that receipts were captured during execution. This review received a redacted export, not an independent recording of the whole cloud runtime. Separate visual-tool invocation logs were not provided.
evidence.retrieval_limit: Evidence was returned through the expected existing email identity. This does not independently prove that email and the previously used chat interface share one execution runtime.

not_verified: Operation on code50 or any later client version.
Two personal AIs handing off a live task or competing for a lease.
Independent wake or recovery after long idle.
The earlier Google Play failure; it was not retried in this task.
Migration of another phone from its existing control chain.
First-time installation by an independent user, other devices or every App workflow.
publication_boundary: No note title or body, source-post text or author, screenshots, user or connection identifiers, phone identifiers, credentials or private paths are included.
